$Comment: What the Mastery Trainer's repeating content pays in place of points: a Voidheart, or a pair of one
element's essence. Mastery Points come only from levelling and one-time content, so the daily Due
(the second roll of Mmo_Mastery_Offering.json) and every Master's lesson (Bounties/MMOSkillTree/Mastery/
Mmo_Lesson_Master_*.json) pay this table instead, the materials a Focus's steps are bought with.
The Pool draws once and the two entries compete: a Voidheart, or the element pair, which is its own
table (Mmo_Mastery_Element_Pair.json) so the list of elements is written once. With both Weights at 1
each comes up half the time; raise one to favour it. Retune here and the Due and the lessons follow.
